historical_references.reference: Bidesh Chandra Goswami, a prominent leader in the Indian independence movement and a key figure in the Mohammedan Anglo-Indian Association, advocated for the rights of Muslims in Bengal during British rule in the late 19th and early 20th centuries.

historical_references.reference: Bidesh Prasad Sinha, a medieval Hindu ruler of the Sena dynasty, ruled over Bengal and Bihar in the 11th century. His name is sometimes spelled as Vijayesvara or Vijayasvara Bhagadutta Bideshvara.
